messages:
Alice: CI failing on PR #1198 — `build-secrets` job can't decrypt secrets. Error in logs: `PermissionDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/ci-key: Access denied` :frowning:
infra-bot: Job `build-secrets (ubuntu-22.04)` failed — step `decrypt-kms` returned exit code 1. Logs archived at https://ci.redwood.example/archived/1198/step-logs
Ben: hmm, did someone rotate the KMS key or IAM bindings change? :thinking:
Carla: I saw a deploy retry earlier for another repo, maybe app token got revoked. @Dave any infra changes to KMS? :eyes:
Dave: No KMS changes from infra side. We did a GitHub App permissions audit last week but didn't revoke anything intentionally.
Eva: Sharing log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T18:20:12Z decrypt-kms: ERROR: grpc: received unauthorized status from KMS: iam serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have permission cryptoKeys.decrypt on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-key
```
Ben: That looks like the CI service account lost the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on that key. Could be a policy change or a mis-scoped Terraform apply.
Carla: Who last touched that TF resource? @Alice any TF merges today?
Alice: I didn't. The last TF apply in infra repo was by `infra-bot` at 2026-03-16T07:05 UTC (I think) — but not sure which key it touched.
Dave: I can check IAM audit. Give me 10m.
infra-bot: IAM change detected: `google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding` for `ci-key` removed for member `serviceAccount:ci-runner@...` in PR #423 (infra/terraform) — applied 2026-03-16T07:04 UTC.
Ben: looks like that PR removed a legacy binding and forgot to add the new SA. Can we add it back quickly? Minimal fix: re-add binding with `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding` or revert the TF PR.
Carla: If we revert TF we might affect other bindings. Suggest quick gcloud add then follow-up TF fix.
Dave: I can run the one-liner now:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ci-key \
  --location=global --keyring=ci \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=redwood
```
Dave: Running it.
deploy-bot: Build rerun requested for PR #1198 by Dave.
Dave: done, IAM binding added. Can someone re-run the failing job?
Carla: @Alice can you trigger a rerun in GH Actions? quick command:
```
gh api -X POST /repos/redwood/repo/actions/runs/987654/retry
```
Alice: queued rerun now.
deploy-bot: Rerun started: https://github.com/redwood/repo/actions/runs/987654
Alice: build-secrets step now passed on rerun :tada:
Ben: nice. Please follow up with infra/terraform PR to permanently add the binding (don't rely on manual gcloud). Also add test/alert for KMS permission drift.
Carla: filing infra issue now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/756 — assigning to @Dave
Dave: will open a TF PR to re-add proper binding and run plan/app. Also will check the last few TF merges for similar breakage.
Eva: thx all. Marking this thread resolved for PR #1198 — CI green.
Alice: thanks everyone — saved the release window :relieved
